_meta.title: Checkpoint release manifest: Cumulative-Goodness Free-Riding in Forward-Forward Networks (NeurIPS 2026)
_meta.release_policy: Minimal public release: only the 4 files with availability 'public_hf' (subset 'minimal': the seed-42 stage1_best checkpoints of the four central CIFAR-100 arms of main-text Table 3, gamma=0, gated kappa=0, cumulative gamma=0.7 and MGC) are uploaded to the Hugging Face repository. Every other file listed here ('on_request') is available from the author on request (amir.usefi75@gmail.com); its SHA-256 below lets the recipient verify it. The Stage-2 heads (stage2_best.pt) are not public: retrain the Stage-2 probe from a released stage1_best.pt (RELEASE_CHECKPOINTS.md, 'Retraining the Stage-2 probe').

availability_values.public_hf: uploaded to the Hugging Face repository at hf_path (license CC BY 4.0)
availability_values.on_request: not on the Hub; available from the author on request. hf_path is the path that release/stage_release.py --subset full gives the file when it is staged for sharing

minimal.description: public Hugging Face release: seed-42 stage1_best of the CIFAR-100 gamma=0, gated kappa=0, cumulative gamma=0.7 and MGC arms (main-text Table 3)

full.description: every result-bearing checkpoint listed in this manifest (the 4 public files plus the 94 available on request)

_meta.hashing: SHA-256 over the full file bytes (Python hashlib, 8 MiB chunks). Archive members were streamed from the Google Drive export zips without extraction; zipfile verified each member's CRC-32. Extracted copies were cross-checked against their archive member's CRC-32.
_meta.source_paths: relative to FF_HOME (the root that contains amir-porjects/ and ff-next/); 'archive.zip::member' means a member of that zip file
_meta.files_per_run: stage1_best.pt (validation-selected Stage-1 network incl. EMA weights; S1/S1-TTA numbers) and stage2_best.pt (Stage-1 network + Stage-2 head; S2/S2-TTA numbers). *_last.pt resume files are not part of the release.
_meta.resumed_runs_note: None of these trainers saved RNG state in checkpoints, so a resumed run is not a bitwise continuation of an uninterrupted run; the camera-ready trainers save and restore it.
lineage_notes: MGC-D128 seed 42 comes from the local DGX Spark (GB10) run (mgc_rebuttal/checkpoints); seeds 123/456 from Colab.

Squared-hinge seed 42 (both arms) comes from the Colab run in mgc_rebuttal/checkpoints_from_drive. The mgc_rebuttal/checkpoints/ff_cifar10_hinge_*seed42* files are from aborted DGX runs (no final evaluation) and are NOT released.

CIFAR-100 trio: stage1_best from the extracted copies in ff-next/checkpoints/trio (CRC-32 equal to the archive members), stage2_best streamed from ff_cifar100_multiseed-20260425T214118Z-3-00{1..7}.zip.
not_released: CIFAR-10 gamma=0 L4/D256 seed 42 (the published run): checkpoint not recoverable; the only seed-42 gamma=0 checkpoints left come from the component-ablation run, not the published run.
Tiny ImageNet, text-domain and BP-control runs: not part of this release (run logs and metrics only).
CIFAR-100 32-expert MoE gamma=0.7 baseline (tab:cifar100_multiseed): seed-42 run not retained.
